authors_manifesto_body: Our main motivation behind this web app is to provide Mallorca's fishing community with a complete and modern tool. We firmly believe in promoting responsible, sustainable fishing, supporting the conservation of our marine environment and respect for current regulations so future generations can also enjoy the richness of our coasts.

quiz_q_daily_limit: What is the daily catch limit for recreational sea fishing in the Balearics?
quiz_q_daily_limit_explanation: The legal cap is 5 kg plus one fish per license per day.
quiz_q_zone_species: In which of these zones is {{speciesName}} commonly found?

quiz_q_reserve_not_official: Which of these is NOT an official Marine Reserve in Mallorca?
quiz_q_reserve_not_official_explanation: Cala Rajada does not have an officially declared marine reserve.
quiz_q_reserve_document: Which document is mandatory to fish inside a Marine Reserve in the Balearics?
quiz_q_reserve_document_explanation: A weekly responsible declaration and boat authorization are required.
quiz_q_license_duration: How many years is the recreational sea fishing license valid for in the Balearics?
quiz_q_license_duration_explanation: The recreational fishing license is valid for 3 years.
